title: Forgot password, and back
persona: A returning user who cannot remember their password and is in a hurry.
goal: Find how to reset a password from the sign-in screen, see what the app asks for, try an empty and a malformed email, then go back to sign-in. Do not submit a real reset.
success: The reset path explains what it will do, rejects empty and malformed emails with a message, and returns to the sign-in screen cleanly.
